# «Зведений каталог метричних книг» — research index

**Status: all 17 archives executed on 2026-08-22 — see `PLAN.md` and the `migration/2026-08-22-*` folders.** **Start here:** `SUMMARY.md` (one row per section, regenerated by `tools/summary.py`) and `PLAN.md` (classes A–H/P, order of execution, checks). Individual research files are listed below.

Source PDFs live one level up (`migration/acmb/*.pdf`); `mbv4` (т. 4: ДАДоО, ДАІФО, ДАЛуО, ДАОО, ДАПО) is already done — see `migration/2026-08-21-dadoo-mbv4/` and `migration/2026-08-22-tom4-dajfo-daluo-daoo-dapo/`. `mbv2.pdf` is byte-identical to `mbv9-b2.pdf` (same md5) — **volume 2 is missing**.

Tooling in `tools/`: `run.py <book> <ARCHIVE> <printed_from> <printed_to>` extracts the section with pdftotext (auto-detects the printed→pdf page offset), parses it (`parse_v4.py`), snapshots the archive's fonds/inventories and the files of the referenced fonds from the DB, compares (`compare_v4.py`) and writes `<book>-<ARCHIVE>.md` + `work/<book>-<ARCHIVE>/actions-<ARCHIVE>.json` (row-level inputs for a later migration). `tools/sections.txt` lists every section with its printed page range.

Each research file reports, per section: parse stats (fonds / blocks / справи / confessions), refs whose fond / опис / file is missing in the DB, existing files lacking title / «метрична книга» tag / years, year disagreements (DB vs catalog), summary-fond title/years vs DB, DB files in the referenced описи that the catalog doesn't list, suspicious high codes (glue candidates), and the title patterns of referenced files that are not in the `Метрична книга. …` form (placeholders the catalog could name).

Execution plan (per archive, after review): A create missing справи · B add MK tags · C fill bare titles/years · D fond years · E glued duplicates · F typo-fonds · G placeholder titles — the same generator as `migration/2026-08-22-tom4-dajfo-daluo-daoo-dapo/generate.py`, pointed at `work/<book>-<ARCHIVE>/`.
